newsitem.title: JAPAN: ANA sees revenues rising to 1.15 trln yen in 2001.
newsitem.headline: ANA sees revenues rising to 1.15 trln yen in 2001.

text.p: All Nippon Airways (ANA) said in a statement on Wednesday that it expects revenues to increase to 1.15 trillion yen in 2001 from an expected 880 billion yen in the 1996/97 fiscal year.
The statement said that international revenues were expected to increase by 8.9 percent a year over the course of its mid-term plan to 2001.
It also said that operating profit was expected to increase to between 30-35 billion yen by 2001 as a result of cost reductions resulting from progress in deregulation and productivity increases.
